observations: Photo 0: Black alternator unit with cooling vent slots, electrical connector plug, and attached wiring harness, shown against a plain fabric background with a watermark 'FIDEL AUTOS GLOBAL POSTED ON JIJI'.
Photo 1: Same alternator from a different angle showing the pulley/rotor shaft threads, mounting ear, and a wiring loom.
Photo 2: Close-up of the rear mounting face and pulley area showing surface dust/grime and an old wiring clip.
No engine block, cylinder head, wiring loom bundle, or any other major engine component is visible in any photo — only a single alternator is shown.
No manufacturer markings, part number, or 'M274' code is legible in any photo.

claims.claim: Mercedes-Benz C300 2015 M274 engine direct tokunbo
claims.evidence: Photos 0-2 show only an alternator, not an engine assembly; no engine block or M274 markings are visible.
No origin stickers, customs tags, or OEM part number visible in any photo.

risks.proof: Clear photo of stamped part number or OEM sticker matching M274 alternator spec

risks.risk: Corrosion or water damage on internal windings not visible externally
risks.proof: Photo of opened housing or rotor/stator assembly
risks.if_unproven: priced as average used condition, risk of internal damage

risks.risk: Mismatched or missing connector plug affecting compatibility
risks.proof: Close-up photo of connector pins matching OEM C300 wiring diagram

proof_requests: Photo of the alternator's stamped part number or OEM label
Video of the alternator spinning with voltage output test
Photo showing the item alongside the actual vehicle or engine bay it was removed from
response.reason: The photos clearly show a single used alternator, not an engine as claimed in the text; it can be priced at worst case as an untested used alternator pending proof of function and fitment.
